description: Use this when an agent, MCP or API call failed. Paste the `error` text and/or `http_status`; add the service `url` if known. Returns the cause, the exact fix (e.g. the missing argument), retry_after_seconds and a receipt. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; links this call to your earlier ones (needed to see or remove your watches later).

error.description: The error you got, as text: HTTP status line, JSON-RPC/A2A/MCP error or message. Give this and/or http_status.

http_status.description: Optional: the HTTP status code you got, e.g. 429.

url.description: Optional: public https URL of the agent, MCP server or API that failed.

verbose.description: Optional: true returns the full result with every underlying field. Default: a short answer.

name: gaip_diagnose
title: Why did my agent or API call fail?
